sentences.quote: Hanzawa, 60, who is currently the head of the main banking unit, will succeed Hironori Kamezawa on April 1, MUFG said in a statement on Tuesday. Kamezawa, 64, who has been CEO since 2020, will become chairman.
sentences.text: MUFG announced in December 2025 that Junichi Hanzawa would succeed Hironori Kamezawa as president and group CEO, with Kamezawa moving to chairman, effective April 1, 2026.

In the same reshuffle, Masakazu Osawa became president of MUFG Bank, while deputy president Hiroyuki Seki was named president of Mitsubishi UFJ Securities Holdings and Mitsubishi UFJ Morgan Stanley Securities.

Hanzawa said the group would keep taking on challenges to build a strong financial services group that opens up the future, and in his first interview as CEO in July 2026 he said he wants to achieve the 20-year-old goal of becoming one of the world's top five banks.

sentences.quote: Hanzawa, 60, who is currently the head of the main banking unit, will succeed Hironori Kamezawa on April 1, MUFG said in a statement on Tuesday. Kamezawa, 64, who has been CEO since 2020, will become chairman.
sentences.text: Hanzawa, a career MUFG insider and former head of the main banking unit, became group CEO in April 2026, succeeding Hironori Kamezawa, who moved to chairman; press coverage cast him as a lifelong insider and widely seen as a safe choice.
Fiscal 2025 net profit reached about JPY 2.43 trillion, a third consecutive record, with ROE of 11.3%.

On capital allocation, the annual dividend was raised to JPY 86, with JPY 96 planned for fiscal 2026, and repurchases for the year to March 2026 totalled roughly JPY 500 billion, a record for the group.
